```{r}
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
folder_path <- "/gpfs/commons/groups/sanjana_lab/nsaravanan/tp_fp_counts"
csv_files <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)


load_and_summarize <- function(file_path) {
  first_line <- readLines(file_path, n = 1)
  n_cols <- length(strsplit(first_line, ",")[[1]])
  df <- read.csv(file_path, header = FALSE)

  if (ncol(df) < 3) stop(paste("File has fewer than 3 columns:", file_path))
  colnames(df)[1:3] <- c("dropout_percentage", "label", "value")

  df_summary <- df %>%
    group_by(dropout_percentage) %>%
    summarize(
      true_positive_count = sum(value[label == "TP"], na.rm = TRUE),
      false_positive_count = sum(value[label == "FP"], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop_last"
    )
  
  return(df_summary)
}

df_list <- lapply(csv_files, load_and_summarize)

names(df_list) <- gsub("\\.csv$", "", basename(csv_files))

print(names(df_list))
print(head(df_list[[1]]))

```
```{r}
outdir <- "/gpfs/commons/groups/sanjana_lab/nsaravanan/tp_fp_plots"
if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)
for (name in names(df_list)) {
  
  df <- df_list[[name]]
  plot_df <- df %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(true_positive_count, false_positive_count),
      names_to = "metric",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      metric = recode(metric,
                      true_positive_count = "True Positives",
                      false_positive_count = "False Positives")
    )

p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = factor(dropout_percentage), y = value, fill = metric)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("False Positives" = "#348feb",
                                 "True Positives" = "#e85c47")) +
    labs(
      x = "Percent Dropout",
      y = "Total Count",
      title = paste0("TP & FP Across Dropout Percentages - ", name),
      fill = ""
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(size = 1, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.25, "cm"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    )
  
  print(p)
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(outdir, paste0("TP_FP_", name, ".pdf")),
    plot = p,
    width = 13,
    height = 6
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

folder_path <- "/gpfs/commons/groups/sanjana_lab/nsaravanan/tp_fp_counts"
csv_files <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

load_and_summarize_avg <- function(file_path) {
  df <- read.csv(file_path, header = FALSE)
  if (ncol(df) < 3) stop(paste("File has fewer than 3 columns:", file_path))
  colnames(df)[1:3] <- c("dropout_percentage", "label", "value")
  
  summary_df <- df %>%
    group_by(dropout_percentage, label) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      p20 = quantile(value, 0.20, na.rm = TRUE),
      p80 = quantile(value, 0.80, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop_last"
    )
  
  filename <- basename(file_path)
  title_str <- sub(
    ".*counts_([0-9.eE+-]+)_([0-9.eE+-]+)_([0-9.eE+-]+).*",
    "h2 - \\1 | N - \\2 | pi - \\3",
    filename
  )
  
  summary_df$title <- title_str
  return(summary_df)
}

df_avg_list <- lapply(csv_files, load_and_summarize_avg)
names(df_avg_list) <- gsub("\\.csv$", "", basename(csv_files))

print(names(df_avg_list))
print(head(df_avg_list[[1]]))
print(unique(df_avg_list[[1]]$title))


```
```{r}
outdir <- "/gpfs/commons/groups/sanjana_lab/nsaravanan/tp_fp_plots"
if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)

for (name in names(df_avg_list)) {
  df <- df_avg_list[[name]]
  
  title_str <- sub(".*counts_([0-9.eE+-]+)_([0-9.eE+-]+)_([0-9.eE+-]+).*",
                   "h2 - \\1 | N - \\2 | pi - \\3", name)
  
  plot_df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      metric = recode(label,
                      "TP" = "True positives",
                      "FP" = "False positives")
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = factor(dropout_percentage), 
                           y = mean_value, 
                           fill = metric)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", 
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
             width = 0.8) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = p20, ymax = p80),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
                  width = 0.2,
                  size = 0.8,
                  color = "black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("False positives" = "#348feb",
                                 "True positives" = "#e85c47")) +
    labs(
      x = "Percent dropout",
      y = "Average count",
      title = paste0("TP & FP across dropout percentages | ", title_str),
      fill = ""
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(size = 1, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1, color = "black"),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.25, "cm"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16, color = "black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank()
    )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(outdir, paste0("TP_FP_avg_", name, ".pdf")),
    plot = p,
    width = 13,
    height = 6
  )
}
```
